shapeSummary: Single 42 mm diameter x 19 mm wide wheel with its axis along Z, centered at X=0 and Z=0 and resting on Y=0 (axis at Y=21). A plain annular tire (R15 to R21) surrounds a white hub. The hub has a recessed flat disc on the -Z side, a central boss, and twelve radial teeth (3 mm wide) on the +Z side. A 3 mm D-shaped bore passes through the hub.
warnings: Dimensions come from unverified listing text, not a dimensioned drawing.
Tire tread lugs are omitted, so the tire is a plain annulus.
Hub recess depth, boss diameter, tooth height and tooth radial extent are estimated from the images.
D-bore flat depth is assumed (about 2.7 mm across the flat) and the bore is assumed to pass fully through.
Teeth are modeled as rectangular radial blocks, 3 mm wide with roughly 3 mm gaps at the mid radius.
Only one wheel of the pair is modeled.

tire = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(21).circle(15).extrude(19).translate((0,0,-9.5))
disc = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(15.5).extrude(2).translate((0,0,-6))
boss = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(4).extrude(13).translate((0,0,-6))
body = tire.union(disc).union(boss)
for i in range(12):

             .translate((13.25, 0, -4))
             .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), i * 30))
    body = body.union(tooth)
